correctness.rationale: Direct entrywise verification of the explicit Hermitian first-moment observable X: L†X=-I. Its dark eigenvalues are h+eta+n/gamma and the bright-hub 2x2 determinant is h(h+eta)-n/(4J²)>0. X>0 implies finite total survival integral and capture probability one; tr(X rho0) gives h+eta+n w/gamma for all allowed density matrices. AM--GM proves both unique positive-rate optimizers for w>0. The gamma=0 bright subsystem and persistent dark component are treated separately. 180 full-Liouvillian tests corroborate, not establish, the proof.

value.rationale: The scalar initial dark weight provides a complete preparation-dependent mean-time classification for uniform independently dephased leaves; exact optimal sink and noise rates offer a quantitative design rule balancing dark-state leakage and Zeno suppression. The discontinuity between arbitrarily weak and absent dephasing gives a physically motivated nonperturbative boundary, and the theorem is not a mere renaming of a source-only noise calculation.
